agent_notes: The official website identifies the institution as Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology at Kumarganj, Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh; the degree catalogue includes an explicitly labelled Azamgarh Campus B.Sc. Agriculture programme, which is retained as a university programme rather than treated as a separate institution.

The degree catalogue is the official Programme Offered by University PDF. The current 2026 diploma/certificate catalogue is the official information brochure linked from the university page; programme duration and eligibility are populated only where that brochure explicitly states them. Degree-course duration and eligibility are left null because the central degree catalogue does not state them.

Normal curl TLS failed with the managed proxy exact self-signed certificate-in-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for confirmed public Google/Bing and nduat.org GETs. Career mappings were reviewed against the read-only career_nodes table; nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings use medium/low confidence where the tree has no exact discipline node.
